## Why it matters

Shidianguji is an open digital library of Chinese classical texts, offering punctuated and fully searchable editions of works ranging from ancient canons to imperial-era compilations.

Presenting these editions alongside images of the original pages lets researchers verify readings against the source, making it a practical tool for studying pre-modern Chinese history and literature.
